title: EMM Peril Codes
text:
EMM Peril Codes

Peril codes for custom models supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

UNICEDE
/2 supports the following perils for risks
 associated with custom models in 
Touchstone Re
's
 Advanced Loss Modification (ALM) and 
CATRADER
's
 Exposure Management Module (EMM).

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
| PFO | Fire only |
| PWS | Windstorm only |
| PFL | Flood only |
